request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Recolour only his skin: the pale yellow-green skin of his face, ears, neck, shoulders and chest becomes a cooler pale jade mint green, colour #a3d1b5, with #6aa98a shadows: clearly a blue-ish mint, not yellow-green. Do not change any shape: keep the closed sleepy eyes, the nose, the teeth, the tin bucket hat, the straps, the club, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
